t: This is the Temperance Billiard Hall at 90 Fulham High Street, now a pub called The Temperance. It's a Grade II listed building. It was designed by Norman Evans, an architect best known for the dozen and a half billiard halls he created for the Temperance Billiard Hall Company, part of the temperance movement's idea of a respectable place to play. So this is one of a whole family of buildings, and the name over the door still points back to that history.
